title: Agents bounded by owner tool permissions only (agent profile, no budgets, agent mode default)
user_story: As the researcher I set which tools and permissions agents get; within that, the AI decides how many steps, calls and how long it works, and I can always stop it.

requirements.description: tools.agent_profile (default read, compute, network, workspace_write; tools [*]) and tools.client_profiles (chatgpt/hermes/antigravity = agent) are validated on save; unknown permissions refused.
Agent/client grants carry no call, wall or output budget; the agent loop has no step limit; explicit budgets set by other callers are still enforced; each tool keeps its own manifest timeout.
The user Stop cancels an unbounded loop; identical repeated calls add a NO PROGRESS hint and a tool.no_progress event without stopping.

Chat defaults to tool_mode=agent with the profile grant (compute tools usable), session isolation [-] and explicit narrowing still apply, user-requested tools still need approval, prose streams live but tool-protocol blocks never do, and legacy stays selectable.

nonfunctional: One model reply keeps aiws.max_turn_s as a transport timeout (hang protection), the loop has none
postconditions: Profile governs chat, MCP bridge and ephemeral sessions
acceptance_criteria: 60 calls beyond the former 50/12 limits succeed
Default chat runs a compute registry tool

scenarios.expected: Native default profile and agent mode
Agent grant has no budgets and follows the profile
External clients use their profiles; unknown clients the narrow fallback
18 steps and a NO PROGRESS hint
Default chat runs a compute tool

recovery: Set aiws.tool_mode=legacy or narrow tools.agent_profile in Settings; revert profiles.py usage. TASK-AGENT-PROFILE-662, max three cycles.
test_environment: Models MOCKED (scripted replies / engine streams); registry, runtime subprocess tools, sessions, orchestrator, config are real in disposable data.

review.method: Same-agent review (not independent): owner decision no budgets vs. per-tool hang timeouts; legacy regressions found (explicit run_tools, streaming, partial) and fixed.

tdd.scope: RED: before implementation 11/11 ERROR (profiles module missing). GREEN: 12/12 PASS (streaming scenario added during implementation).
